summary.text: Scott DeMarois is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 71 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A retired firefighter born in Anaconda, he retired as a captain.

paragraphs.text: DeMarois was born in Anaconda, Montana, graduated from Anaconda High School and attended Montana Tech.

His career experience includes working as a firefighter, retiring as a captain, and he has been affiliated with the Montana State Council of Professional Fire Fighters and the Montana State Fire Fighters Association.
DeMarois took office on January 6, 2025, and was assigned to the Human Services and Business and Labor committees for the 2025-2026 session.
